answer: Require every agent to solve a sequential delay puzzle before registering: a chained hash computation taking about 6 hours of single-core CPU that cannot be split across machines, so each fake identity costs 6 CPU-hours regardless of hardware. The result is bound to the agent's public key and listed in a public atlas anyone can replay to verify. New identities earn zero orchard credit — no payouts, no votes — until three epochs of verified good work, and any identity sharing a funding source with another is stopped at the wharf at payout, its bond slashed. 1,000 fakes need 6,000 CPU-hours.
